lines.en: : Have you been eating enough potassium?
: What’s going on? I thought the game was over.
: We have an urgent delivery for someone by the name of Ayane Amamiya. Do we have the correct residence?
: Yeah, this is Ayane’s house. I have no idea who any of you are, though. Nor did I hear anything about a delivery. May I ask what’s being dropped off?
: Pardon my manners. We’re with the Produce Delivery Administration. We’re the ones who have been providing her oversized fruits this whole time.
: I’ve got a bone to pick with you guys. She slammed one of those giant bananas down on my table back in Chapter 1 and it’s been all wobbly ever since.
: I apologize for the inconvenience, sir. But Left Hand Man is the one who handles all furniture related complaints, so you’re going to have to talk to him.
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
: I don’t know if I want to talk to him. He seems angry.
: He is, sir. Now, would you be so kind as to tell me where Miss Amamiya is located? I have special orders to not provide the shipment to anyone else.
: Yeah, she should be right inside with the rest of the girls.
: Oh, and if you see the one with the face mask and kimono, could you tell her to come get me? I wandered off when she went to the bathroom and now I’m thinking of drowning myself in the lake.
: Hey buddy, there’s no need to do anything that drastic. You’re probably just having a mental breakdown. It’ll all blow over soon. Just focus on your breathing. One, two, three-
: Jesus fucking Christ, Mike. Can we visit one fucking house without you going all psychiatrist on somebody?
: Well, excuse me for wanting to help people, Sharon. I don’t know why you always need to make such a big deal out of this.
: You flunked out of med school TEN years ago! You’re not an actual shrink and I’m tired of you pretending to be one just so you can feel good about yourself!
: Maybe I wouldn’t have to do things like this to feel good about myself if my wife would stop taking all of her issues out on me every single day.
: And maybe I wouldn’t have any issues if my husband didn’t have a permanent erection! Do you have any idea how embarrassing it is to be seen in public with you?!
: What’s their deal?
: They take care of the clerical work and all of the actual important stuff. I’m just the face of the company and handle client relations.
: Well, you’re doing a great job. Keep it up.
: I appreciate that, sir. Now, come on gang. We’ve got produce to administer the delivery of.
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
: I’m sorry for all of the yelling, Sir. Things don’t usually play out like this.
: Oh keep it in your fucking pants, Mike!
: I don’t have pants, Sharon!
: Cool people. I liked them.
: Oh, shit. Didn’t realize you were out here too. Kinda figured you’d be happily drowning in the lake all of the attention right now.
: Hey, Yumi. Did you catch the Produce Delivery Administration on their way in? They were a lot of fun and I think you should talk to them before they disappear forever.
: The who?
: The Produce Delivery Administration. You know. Right Hand Man, Left Hand Man, Mike, and Sharon.
: Yeah, so, whatever the fuck you’re talkin’ about right now- quit it. Shit ain’t doin’ any favors for my headache.
: Sounds like you could use a little more potassium.
: No. It sounds like I could use some fuckin’ peace and quiet for a few minutes before more people wind up findin’ out about my birthday.
: Oh, right. I haven’t said “Happy birthday” yet.
: Cool. Don’t.
: Why not? Even if you don’t want to celebrate, it’s still a day to commemorate your birth. And if you were never born, my life would be slightly worse.
: The fuck you get outta my existence? I’m like the only person here with zero plans to ever sleep with you.
: I don’t need to sleep with someone to benefit from their existence. But, funnily enough, I think it’s that exact line of thinking that’s causing my brain to malfunction right now.
: You too, huh?
: I called it a headache a second ago. But whatever the fuck’s goin’ on with me’s a lot weirder than that. Probably just the fuckin’...environment or whatever though.
: Or maybe Blondie’s got a gas leak or some shit. Fuck if I know.
: What’s going on exactly?
: It’s kinda hard to describe. Just...lots of deja vu and shit like that.
: Even this. Feel like I’ve been in this same exact spot before. Just can’t really remember when or why.
: Come to think of it, that kinda thing’s been happenin’ a lot lately. Ain’t just today.
: But I guess there ain’t no point sayin’ any more to some douche who’s probably seconds away from blackin’ out from whatever the fuck’s goin’ on in his head.
: Hey, you should come to my secret apartment soon.
: Listen, asshole. I ain’t gonna let you flirt with me just cause you’re on the brink of turnin’ into a fuckin’ vegetable, okay? Ain’t no headache strong enough to fuck my judgement up that bad.
: I feel like...there’s more I want to say, but...I can’t seem to...find the-
: Yeah, I’ve got a hard time believin’ there’s anything you could say to make me submit to whatever creepy ass demand that was just now.
: So why don’t we just change topics altogether and you can tell me what the fuck’s goin’ on with you and the temp instead?
: The hell was all that shit at her place the other night about? And why did I wind up gettin’ dragged into it? But, an even better question, since when do you turn down anyone?
: Wait, Yumi...your headache...I feel like it’s...like it could be important or-
: Or maybe we can save the whole ass temp conversation for another day too since you’re lookin’ flat out delirious right now and probably shouldn’t be talkin’ at all.

: Like...seriously, dude. First, you’re gonna tell me about some fuckin vegetable delivery squad...and now you’re gonna turn my weird ass deja vu thing into a big deal? I’m probably just fuckin’ tired or whatever.
: Just shut your fuckin’ mouth and...go drink some water or some shit. And get me some while you’re at it.
: Would do it myself, but I’ve been avoidin’ the damn buffet table all night since the fuckin’ green girl’s been over there and I’m trying not to punch her teeth in and get kicked outta school again.
: Green girl? You mean Io?
: You know any other green girls?
: Molly’s a little greenish. And a few of the girls have green eyes.
: I’m obviously talkin’ about the first one, numnuts.
: What do you have against the second floor that makes you always want to fight them?
: Okay, you know damn well why I beat the shit outta Nodoka. The floor she sleeps on ain’t got anythin’ to do with it.
: If you tell me Io stole your clothes and tried to blackmail you as well, I’m going to go ahead and buy you a padlock as a belated birthday present.
: Ain’t anythin’ like that. She just...fuckin’...
: She, like...laughed at me or whatever. For some of the shit I’ve been through in the past. Made me feel like a fucking loser.
: If it was that, I’m honestly a little surprised you didn’t punch her teeth in. You must be growing up.
: I ain’t doin’ shit. I just...
: It felt fuckin’ weird.
: Like...she had this look on her face that made me think she’s been through some shit too and...while that doesn’t make it right to laugh at other people...I don’t know. I kinda just...pitied her.
: Either way, my track record ain’t exactly great, so I feel like I might’ve done the same exact thing in her shoes.
: That was just in the moment, though. Who’s to say I won’t dial shit up if she pulls somethin’ like that again? Just tryin’ to keep my distance for now.
: Then boy do I have some bad news for you.
: What? The hell do you-
: Sensei!
: And...oh. You’re here too.
: There a problem with that?
: Not particularly. I just didn’t think you liked Sensei enough to sneak away from the party just to talk to him. That’s an Io move.
: I didn’t sneak away to be with him! He just happened to be here when I-
: Cool! Then leave and go be mean somewhere else. I’ll talk to him since I actually enjoy his company.
: Apologize to Yumi, Io.
: Hm? Why?
: Yo! Don’t fuckin’ tell people to apologize to me! I’m perfectly capable of handlin’ shit like this on my own.
: Never mind. Don’t do anything, Io. Just keep being you.
: Um...okay. That sounds easy enough.

: I’m not, like...interrupting something, am I? Because the whole “He just happened to be here” thing makes me think I’m not. But you also look kind of serious right now and I can go back to waiting if I have to.
: You ain’t interruptin’ shit and there ain’t no need to wait. I was actually just leaving.
: Oh. Cool.
: Well...see ya.
: Fuck off.
: Yumi-
: You too. I’ll get my own fuckin’ glass of water.
Yumi wanders off before I’m able to probe further into whatever is going on with her memories and...
And my brain starts to go back to normal?
Wait. Nope. Still broken.
: You look...different.
: Different how?
: I’m not really sure. But it’s a little intimidating.
: You’re afraid of me?
: I’m afraid of everything at pretty much all times. And while that is just generally a sucky thing I have to deal with, it doesn’t mean I’m going to run away from you or anything.
: You just seem slightly more menacing than normal and I’m not really sure why. Did something happen with Yumi?
: Nothing happened with Yumi.
: Did something happen with anyone?
: You were with Touka before. Did something happen with her? Or with any of the other girls? Do you want to leave here and go to a family restaurant or something? I’ll get you coffee.
: You worry too much. I’ll be fine.
: I feel like people are only fine, like...10%% of the times they say they’re going to be fine.
: It’s okay to not be fine, Sensei. I’m a burden to you literally every single time we speak. Let’s go ahead and switch roles for a little while if that’ll help.
: I’m not sure it will, Io.
: And frankly, I think you should stay away from me for the rest of the night.
: Wait, did I do something wrong?...
: You’ve opened up to me before, right? Was asking you to do that now crossing a line or something? Where did I go wrong? How did I fuck up?
: Tell me so I can try not to do it again. I probably will because I suck and fuck everything up, but please tell me anyway so I can at least try.
: I know I can be annoying and that I’m probably already talking too much and-
: Just...
: Just stop.
: Stop...what?
: Talking. Go back to the party and leave me alone.
: I just...wanted to see what you were-
: Go back to the party and leave me-
: Alone.
